title: Frequency-dependent poorer-ear reversal does not establish added hearing-difficulty prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: In 1750 NHANES 2003–2004 adults, adding a frequency-dependent interaural cancellation index reduced weighted hearing-difficulty Brier error by 0.00022641 (0.160%), but both survey-bootstrap intervals included zero; stable incremental prediction beyond standard hearing summaries was not established.
